_note: N440 open world places. Lives in Data/ui because only Data/ui is served by the host (/data/ui/{name}) and copied into the wasm build. Anchors name a city.json poi id (landmark), a node id, or 'site' (the player's site; snapToNode moves it to the closest road node, since CityView gives a site its district center). Offsets are meters from the anchor (x east, z north). Positions are placeholders for the owner to tune.
